beats.label: Prompt bar builds
beats.intent: A clean white prompt bar springs in, reveals controls one by one, then types the prompt.

beats.label: Prompt readable hold
beats.intent: Hold the completed prompt before the bar leaves.

beats.label: Prompt bar exits
beats.intent: The completed prompt bar lifts and dissolves before the text statement arrives.

beats.label: Think deeper
beats.intent: Two words enter from opposite directions with soft spring energy.

beats.label: Think faster
beats.intent: The accent word swaps from deeper to faster in the same optical center.

beats.label: File analysis cards
beats.intent: Three professional file cards cascade in, each with internal icon/title/status choreography.

beats.label: Available now CTA
beats.intent: A warm gradient replaces the file stage and a pill CTA springs into focus.
